CustomField.description: SAL-431: Governance flag set automatically by the "RT - Account - Flag Possible Store Replacement" before-save flow when a CG Cloud Mobile - TSM user changes Name, ShippingStreet and ShippingCity on an Account in a single save (a likely wholesale store replacement). Read-only for TSM users; editable by System Administrators. Read by the "Possible Store Replacements" report. Data owner: Store Operations / System Administrator. Origin: SAL-431.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Auto-set to true when a TSM user changes the store Name and Shipping address together, indicating a possible store replacement to review. Managed by automation; edit only as an administrator correcting a false positive.
CustomField.label: Possible Store Replacement
